About Nortivo

Nortivo is based in Lillestrøm, Norway. We create investment guides and software for testing and automating trading rules.

How we work

We start with what you need to understand or what the software needs to do. Then we agree on the content, rules and how to test the result.

Explore all services

What we’ve built

  • Trading simulation

    Try six fictional entry prices. See when a buy rule triggers and how fees change the profit or loss.

  • 2026 SPY backtest

    We tested a trading rule on historical SPY prices and measured how the timing of orders changed the simulated result.

  • Arc by Nortivo

    An app for budgeting, food logging and manually tracking steps. See screenshots from the private test and try the budget demo.

  • Support

    A support portal where you can submit a request and follow replies through a secure email link.

  • Lune

    A fictional restaurant website. Browse the menu and try selecting a table in the booking demo.

2026 year in review

Nortivo’s progress through November 17, 2026.

Started Nortivo in Lillestrøm

Noah Julian Christensen-Sæter founded Nortivo in September. By November, the site introduced services for investment education, trading software and crypto automation.

Explore all services

Tested a trading rule on SPY

Across 219 trading sessions from January 2 through November 13, the historical simulation returned +2.37%, with a maximum drawdown of −3.88%. The model set order sizes after the close and filled orders at the next open.

Read the results and methods

Built Arc and Lune

Arc by Nortivo reached private testing for budgeting, food logging and step tracking. Lune went live as a fictional restaurant site with an interactive menu and table booking demo.

Arc by Nortivo Lune

Published tools and online support

The homepage now lets visitors replay a simulated trading decision. The fee simulator shows how costs change the outcome, and the support portal lets visitors submit and follow requests.
